## Change

What problem does this solve, and what behavior changes?

## Validation

List build/test commands and results. For hardware tests, include the source
revision, chip/board and toolchain. State failures and paths you could not test.

## Provenance

Credit relevant source or register evidence. If AI materially assisted the work,
briefly name the tool/model and describe your review and validation. AI-assisted
and AI-generated contributions are welcome under our CONTRIBUTING.md policy.
